title: Human-AI Collaboration in Customer Behavior Research: Personalizing Financial Services
venue: Journal of Computer Science and Technology Studies
tldr: Human-AI collaborative frameworks combine machine learning pattern recognition with human contextual intelligence to enhance customer segmentation, personalization, and retention in financial services.
problem_and_motivation: Financial institutions face challenges in executing effective personalization strategies due to technical constraints and organizational readiness gaps. Traditional demographic-based segmentation provides limited predictive power for customer behavior. The black-box nature of AI models creates transparency challenges essential for regulatory compliance and customer trust in financial services.
approach: Integrated data platforms unify disparate customer information across touchpoints using entity resolution algorithms and graph databases.
Real-time processing via event-streaming backbones enables contextually appropriate interventions with millisecond latencies.
Multi-dimensional behavioral segmentation using unsupervised learning identifies up to 15 distinct behavioral segments compared to 4-5 with conventional methods.
Neural network architectures including autoencoders compress high-dimensional customer data into latent representations for clustering.
Human-in-the-loop refinement with sequential review, confidence-based escalation, active learning, and specialized domain teams.
Omnichannel experience orchestration maintains persistent customer context across mobile, web, ATM, and branch locations.
Continuous optimization through multi-armed bandit algorithms and causal inference techniques for personalization effectiveness.
findings: num: Financial institutions implementing advanced analytics experience improvement in customer retention metrics.
num: Advanced clustering algorithms identify up to 15 distinct behavioral segments compared to 4-5 with conventional methods.
num: RNN implementations generate higher predictive accuracy for future purchasing behaviors than conventional ML approaches.
num: Financial institutions implementing formalized knowledge collaboration protocols improve model prediction accuracy.
num: Unified omnichannel orchestration achieves approximately 59% higher customer satisfaction scores.
num: Chase's coordinated personalization delivered 94% higher engagement with financial wellness recommendations.
num: Financial institutions implementing ethical review boards identify more potential adverse impacts during model development.
